title: Signature Hainanese Chicken Rice for Two
description: Tender poached chicken served over deeply aromatic, ginger-pandan scented jasmine rice, accompanied by a savory soy-sesame drizzle and fresh cucumber.
ingredients: 1.5 cups Jasmine rice, rinsed and drained
4 cups Water or stock for poaching
instructions: Rub the chicken legs generously with salt, then rinse thoroughly.
Poach the chicken in simmering water with ginger slices and 1 pandan leaf for 25 minutes until fully cooked.
Transfer cooked chicken immediately into an ice bath for 10 minutes to lock in moisture and create a gelatinous skin.
In a pan, sauté minced garlic and remaining ginger in 1 tbsp sesame oil until fragrant. Add rinsed rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Transfer toasted rice to a rice cooker, add 1.75 cups of reserved chicken poaching broth and knotted pandan leaves, then cook.
Chop the cooled chicken into bite-sized pieces, drizzle with a mixture of light soy sauce, sesame oil, and 2 tbsp warm broth, and serve with the hot rice and cucumber slices.
